zh.title: 《龙珠超宇宙3》先行预告。我喜欢充满龙珠风格的战斗，例如“灵魂变化”，它可以让玩家变身为他们的主人。
zh.summary: 万代南梦宫娱乐计划在2027年之内推出该系列的最新作品《龙珠Xenoverse 3》。在这款游戏中，玩家的化身可以通过龙珠的超级战士们的训练和训练，成为玩家想要的样子。这次我有机会提前体验一下，所以想和大家分享一下我的感受。

en.title: “Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3” advance play report. I enjoyed battles full of Dragon Ball-esque features such as ``Soul Change,'' which allows players to transform into their masters.
en.summary: Bandai Namco Entertainment plans to release the latest work in the series, ``Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3,'' within 2027. In this game, the player's avatar can be trained and trained by Dragon Ball's super warriors to become the player's desired appearance. This time, I had the opportunity to experience it in advance, so I would like to share my impressions with you.

items.title: 「STRANGER THAN HEAVEN」最新ビルドで実感した，時代の手触り。故郷を追われ，日本を目指した青年が興行の世界に足を踏み入れるまで［プレイレポ］
items.summary: セガのRGGスタジオが開発中のアクションアドベンチャー「STRANGERTHANHEAVEN」の最新ビルドを試遊する機会を得た。今回は物語の開幕を告げる1915年のサンフランシスコから小倉編にかけてのストーリーを体験し，呉やミナミでは街歩きやバトルの手触りを確認できた。

zh.title: 《比天堂更奇怪》的最新版本给你一种时代感。一个被迫背井离乡、投向日本的年轻人如何踏入娱乐圈【游玩报道】
zh.summary: 我有机会尝试了世嘉 RGG 工作室目前正在开发的动作冒险游戏“STRANGERTHANHEAVEN”的最新版本。这次，我们从故事开始的1915年旧金山到小仓，感受了吴市和南市的城市漫步和战斗。

en.title: The latest build of "STRANGER THAN HEAVEN" gives you a feel of the times. How a young man who was forced to leave his hometown and set his sights on Japan steps into the world of entertainment [Play Report]

This time, we experienced the story from San Francisco in 1915, which marks the beginning of the story, to Kokura, and got a feel for the city walks and battles in Kure and Minami.

Many people believe that the Ace Combat series originated from a certain arcade game. In theory, the origin of its design can be traced back to the popular arcade air combat works of that year (such as Namco's "Air Combat"). But "Ace Combat" has been an original series on home consoles from the beginning. On June 30, 1995, the first generation of "Ace Combat" was launched on the Japanese PlayStation, followed by other games a few years later.

en.title: To make one hundred and eight knives easy to use: An exclusive interview with the development director of "The Strange Tales of Muramasa" by Machine Core
en.summary: For many players, "Obi Muramasa" is a work that is difficult to forget easily. The delicate Japanese-style hand-painted art, smooth and refreshing horizontal action battles, and the adventure of traveling across Japan and confronting monsters and ghosts together constitute the unique charm of this Vanilla Club work. After many years, this work has reintegrated the contents of the original "Obi Muramasa" and "Genroku's Strange Tales" in the form of "Obi Muramasa's Strange Tales", and added new systems and adjustments to the original ones. For a work that already has a distinctive style, how to bring enough freshness to players while retaining the characteristics of the original work is a problem that needs to be faced in this remake. During TGS2026, I played some of the content of this game, and also interviewed Wataru Nakanishi, the development director of "The Strange Tales of Muramasa", and asked him to talk about the adjustments the development team has made to the combat system, character design and art performance, and how this work hopes to serve as a new platform for new players.

items.title: 和宫崎英高畅聊，寻找“类魂”游戏的魂
items.summary: 动作游戏与难度之间的关系一直十分复杂。 几十年前，古早动作游戏往往难度极高，但这并非总是设计师有意为之。它们之所以难度曲线陡峭，存在大量需要玩家反复试错的关卡或场景，很大程度上是因为在那个年代，开创动作品类的开发者们试图在确保公平性的同时，尽可能考验玩家的精准操作。在游戏行业诞生初期，这是前辈们摸索出来的最佳实践。 随着电影化叙事手法的兴起，许多动作游戏为了呈现引人入胜的剧情而降低难度，使更广泛的玩家群体能够轻松体验。从上世纪90年代末到2010年代中期，玩家可以毫不费力地通关那些游戏，几乎不会遇到任何棘手挑战。与此同时，“忍者龙剑传”系列、《超级肉肉哥》等游戏仍然为追求极致挑战的玩家提供了紧

ja.title: 宮崎英高とチャットして「Souls-like」ゲームの魂を見つけよう
ja.summary: アクション ゲームは常に難易度と複雑な関係にあります。数十年前、古いアクション ゲームは非常に難しい傾向がありましたが、それは常にデザイナーの意図ではありませんでした。急峻な難易度カーブや、プレイヤーが試行錯誤を必要とするレベルやシーンが多いのは、当時、アクションジャンルを開拓した開発者が、公平性を確保しながらプレイヤーの正確な操作を可能な限りテストしようとしたことが大きい。ゲーム業界の初期において、これは先人たちが模索したベストプラクティスでした。映画的な物語技術の台頭により、多くのアクション ゲームは、より幅広いプレイヤー グループが簡単に体験できるように魅力的なプロットを提示するために難易度を下げています。 1990 年代後半から 2010 年代半ばまで、プレイヤーは難しい課題をほとんど感じることなく、これらのゲームを難なくプレイすることができました。同時に、「Ninjagaiden」シリーズや「Super Meat Boy」などのゲームは、究極の挑戦を追求するプレイヤーにとって依然として厳しいチャンスを提供しています。

en.title: Chat with Hidetaka Miyazaki and find the soul of the "Souls-like" game
en.summary: Action games have always had a complicated relationship with difficulty. Decades ago, older action games tended to be extremely difficult, but that wasn't always the intention of the designers. The reason why they have a steep difficulty curve and a large number of levels or scenes that require players to trial and error is largely because at that time, the developers who pioneered the action genre tried to test the players' precise operations as much as possible while ensuring fairness. In the early days of the game industry, this was the best practice explored by predecessors. With the rise of cinematic narrative techniques, many action games have lowered their difficulty in order to present fascinating plots so that a wider group of players can experience them easily. From the late 1990s to the mid-2010s, players could effortlessly play through those games with almost no tricky challenges. At the same time, games such as the "Ninja Gaiden" series and "Super Meat Boy" still provide tight opportunities for players who pursue the ultimate challenge.
